The English in belongs to expanded in the form of, describing the form enjoyment takes. The source la marks enjoyment of physical sensations. A unique atom la/in is not demonstrated independently of that explanatory recast; leave the relation unbanked without a null.

Second la supplies the object relation after taking possession, rendered of certain enjoyments. Its of is uniquely localized; omitting the uncertain anaphoric de/expanded certain enjoyments does not erase this clear grammatical relation. Full LA glossary includes of.

Retain direct dbang/force and whole gis/by as separate d5/d6 atoms. Full DBANG GIS attests by force of, but the following English of also expresses the source bound genitive after taking possession. Narrow lexical force and instrumental by avoid absorbing that additional nominal relation; no suffix split.

Both Tibetan byung ba predicates share one fronted English occur over two causal alternatives. Selecting the first merely because it appears first would overstate unique occurrence ownership. Omit both with shared-scope reason and do not null either or duplicate occur.

Select bsdus pa/part, exactly glossary-attested, and add the overt kyis/of relation. The source instrumental names what includes the virtues/non-virtues; English reverses this to part of names and forms. These two distinct roles have direct local support, and KYIS glossary includes of. Both part and part of are attested; the tighter version accounts for the explicit relation without overlap.
Whole kyis owns of after part in the inverted inclusion relation. Keep the source instrumental whole; do not invent by or split its suffix.

The positive dge/virtues member is strictly within mi dge/non-virtues and exactly glossary-attested. Its source and English occurrences are distinct from the preceding positive virtues. Keeping this positive member does not introduce an unapproved non- negative-affix rule.

Both proposals affirm the separate existential negative med has no explicit exponent. The existence-denial is unstated; source context may abbreviate a known definition, so this is an alignment absence finding, not an authorized source correction.
